--- HOW 2 REMIX ---
Want to add a character to this game? Follow these instructions carefully to get them in:
1. Scroll down below these instructions & read the rules! DON'T proceed until you've done this!
2. Click the green "Remix" button at the top-right corner (duh)
3. Create a duplicate of the "Player0" sprite, and follow the instructions I put in.
4. Create your character! Replace every costume in the duplicated sprite EXCEPT for the "SizeBox" costume with your character, replace all "Voice" sound clips with your character's voice & set their name.
5. Test your project &, if you like the result, either continue to add more characters or share it!
BONUS: You're also allowed to add characters to the thumbnail & add more music tracks/winner jingles/draw jingles/get ready jingles.
6. Before you share your project, PLEASE make sure that you credit @-Rex- for the Pen Text Engine++!
If you don't want to type their username, here's a template that you can copy and paste:

Credit to @-Rex- for Pen Text Engine++ ( https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/406678232/ ).

--- RULES RECAP ---
Only @Redshell3, @whatsmydiamond, @BarryFans, @laithkablan234, @ZYellow, @Twin138956Scratch, @Kyle3912Again,
@Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, and @OisinFan62 can break these rules.

(!) Only @BarryFans can break these rules
(?) These rules break the Community Guidelines
(O) These rules are optional
Nobody else can break these rules.

1: Don't ruin the project (!)
2: Don't break the community guidelines (?)
3: Don't make your character tiny or giant, that will make it hard to see
4: Don't delete ANYTHING unless someone is having trouble remixing due to too much data or they break rule 3
5: Don't steal OCs and put them in this project (?)
6: Don't modify anything, unless if you know what you're doing.
7: (O) Be sure to credit to @-Rex- for Pen Text Engine++.

If you break any of these rules, it may result in your remix being declared UNOFFICIAL and becoming abandoned. You don't want that, right? To make sure this doesn't happen, remember to check the RULE RECAP in the thumbnail sprite just before you share the project!

Q)lcBOI(n)o5?-g:~u1G.text:
Hey there! If you want to add your own music, first separate your song into it's intro (if it has an intro) and it's looping part in separate sounds, tag "-Start" at the end of the intro's name, then tag "-Loop" at the end of the looping part's name. (Jingles won't have these tags, as they aren't intended to loop.) Add the song's name into either "Add music" block, depending on what scenario it should be for, & finally drop it here! Remember that EVERYTHING must be correct spelling or else it won't work! Running a test recommended!

If the music track or jingle comes from a party game, like Mario Party, Wii Party or WarioWare: MEGA Party Game$, make sure it won't play for users who don't want those music tracks, like SmashBrosFan2020, via the audio-exemption lists & boolean. Same goes for "gets faster" tracks, lyrical music, & non-looping music. Burgnew_On_A_Laptop also recommends you please don't add any more than around 100 music tracks and jingles total, to prevent lag or the dreaded "refusal-to-save glitch" when modifiying the project on less powerful devices. It's also best to refrain from adding too many music tracks longer than 3 minutes (180 seconds) or too many "gets faster" tracks.
